'''TK-3338''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[501st Legion]]. They were part of the forces that boarded the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' in [[1 BBY]] in search of the [[Death Star plans]] that had been stolen by the rebels. TK-3338 was ordered to search the [[starship]] for passengers with [[Stormtrooper Commander]] [[TK-9091]] and fellow [[trooper]]s [[Tarvyn Lareka|TK-4601]] and [[TK-4247]]. When the four discovered [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] on board, she [[Death|killed]] TK-9091 before being [[stun]]ned. TK-3338 and TK-4601 were then part of the escort that brought Organa before their commanding officer, [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
===Searching for a senator===
[[File:Stormtroopers_searching_Tantive_IV.png|thumb|left|A squad including TK-3338 (rear) searched the ''Tantive IV'' for passengers.|250px]]
TK-3338 was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[human]] who served as a [[stormtrooper]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[501st Legion]] under the command of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="The Bucket" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1|the [[Secret mission to Tatooine|capture]] of [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]}}</ref> TK-3338 was stationed on board Vader's [[flagship]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' when it chased down the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]''<ref name="The Bucket" /> following its escape from the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] then deployed from the ''Devastator'' and boarded the [[corvette]] in search of the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]],<ref name="ANH" /> which had been stolen on [[Scarif]].<ref name="RO" />

After the Imperials had successfully captured the rebel [[Starship|vessel]] but failed to find the plans, Vader ordered that [[Stormtrooper Commander]] [[TK-9091]] lead TK-3338, [[Tarvyn Lareka|TK-4601]] and [[TK-4247]] in a search of the ship to find any remaining passengers. The four troopers set about searching corridors, closets and other out-of-the-way places, with TK-9091 in the lead, followed by TK-4601, then TK-3338 and finally TK-4247 bringing up the rear. As they searched, TK-3338 questioned what they would do if they found [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], a [[senator]] and known rebel sympathizer who was believed to be somewhere on the corvette. TK-9091 responded that they would [[stun]] her and bring her to Vader.<ref name="The Bucket" />

===Stunning a senator===
[[File:SquadEscortingLeia.png|thumb|TK-3338 (behind front left trooper) helped escort Leia Organa to Darth Vader.|250px]]
As they continued, TK-9091 spotted Organa in the corridor ahead of them and ordered his men to set their [[blaster]]s to stun. Before the [[commander]] had a chance to fire, the senator shot and [[Death|killed]] him before being hit by a stun blast from TK-4601. TK-4247 checked on TK-9091 and confirmed that he had been killed while TK-4601, who was now the ranking member of the [[squad]], checked to see that Organa had survived. Once the rebel awoke, TK-4601 dragged her to her [[Limb|feet]] and TK-3338 pressed his blaster into her back to prevent her escaping.<ref name="The Bucket" />"

TK-4601 then reported that they had Organa in custody and requested that two more troopers be sent to assist in transporting her to Vader. He also asked to be transfer off active duty, which was granted. Once the two additional troopers—[[TK-7624]] and [[TK-8332]]—arrived, TK-4061 left while TK-3338 and the other three remaining troopers marched Organa to Vader.<ref name="The Bucket" /> The [[Sith]] demanded to know where the [[Death Star]] plans were but the senator feigned ignorance and so he ordered TK-3338 and the others to take her away.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
TK-3338 wore [[stormtrooper armor]] and carried an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
TK-3338 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character was then first identified in the short story "[[The Bucket]]," which was written by [[Christie Golden]] and published as part of the ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'' anthology in [[2017]].<ref name="The Bucket" />
